# HirePulse public data tools

19 public Actors verified in the owner account on October 28, 2026. Choose tools by their actual public evidence and output, not by a promised business outcome. Current Apify Input and Pricing tabs are authoritative.

## Start with a useful first run

- [Inspect website metadata and sitemaps](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/guides/domain-seo-overview-python/)
- [Collect company jobs and build a hiring watchlist](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/guides/greenhouse-lever-ashby-jobs-api/)
- [Generate a Shopify catalog llms.txt draft](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/guides/shopify-catalog-llms-txt/)

Each guide includes an actual dated owner-run sample, runnable input, Python, source limits and an explicit event-charge cap. Owner tests are not customer results. A cap is not a quoted price.

## Current public catalog

- [ATS Job Scraper: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable & More](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse): Scrape company jobs from Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee and SmartRecruiters. Get apply links, hiring summaries and optional new/closed job tracking. Company domains in, structured JSON out for recruiting, B2B lead research, n8n, Make and Apify MCP. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-job-pulse/pricing).
- [Keyword Research: Google Autocomplete & Suggestions](https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume): Generate Google Autocomplete keyword suggestions from seed phrases for SEO, content planning and keyword research. Export keywords, source and availability fields as JSON for n8n, Make and Apify MCP. Public mode returns no measured search volume, CPC or difficulty. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/keyword-search-volume/pricing).
- [Domain SEO Overview: Metadata, Sitemaps & Keywords](https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview): Public website signals: titles, meta descriptions, sitemap and autocomplete suggestions, plus a Chrome popularity tier (CrUX rank bucket, not visits). No traffic, rank or search volume. No lookup or result charges; Actor start fees apply. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/domain-seo-overview/pricing).
- [YouTube Transcript Scraper: Bulk Videos, Shorts & Timestamps](https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper): Extract YouTube transcripts in bulk from videos, Shorts and live replays with accessible captions. Export clean text, caption language and optional timestamps for RAG, summaries and content research. No YouTube API key; works with n8n, Make and Apify MCP. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper/pricing).
- [Google Jobs Alternative: ATS & Public Job Listings](https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper): Google Jobs alternative for job research: search public job feeds by keyword or fetch company ATS jobs by domain. Export titles, employers, locations and apply links as JSON. Use with n8n, Make or Apify MCP. Default results come from public feeds, not Google Jobs SERPs. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper/pricing).
- [Google Ads Transparency Scraper: Competitor Ads by Domain](https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper): Scrape Google Ads Transparency Center records by company domain: ad creatives, formats, advertisers and first/last shown dates when available. Export JSON for competitor ad research, brand monitoring, n8n, Make and Apify MCP. Includes bulk domains and summary options. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper/pricing).
- [Company Intent Radar: Hiring, Ads & Website Signals](https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar): Research B2B companies by domain: combine ATS hiring, Google Ads Transparency records, website technologies and email DNS signals in one JSON report. Includes source availability and an explainable intent estimate for account qualification, AI sales agents and n8n. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-intent-radar/pricing).
- [AliExpress Search Scraper: Products, Prices & Sales Data](https://apify.com/hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper): Search AliExpress by keyword and export product prices, discounts, ratings, sold counts, images and URLs when available. Choose sort order, currency and destination country. JSON, CSV and Excel exports for product research and repeatable search snapshots. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper/pricing).
- [ATS Detector: Find a Company's Job Board (Free)](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-detector): Detect a company applicant tracking system from its domain: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters. Return the public job-board URL and available job count as JSON. No Actor fee; useful for recruiting, lead enrichment, n8n and Apify MCP. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ats-detector/pricing).
- [Website Tech Stack Detector: BuiltWith Alternative, Bulk API](https://apify.com/hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector): Detect website technologies, CMS, ecommerce platforms, analytics and ad pixels by domain: Meta Pixel, Google Ads tags, GA4 and more. Add public DNS email-provider signals and optional change tracking. Structured JSON for B2B lead qualification, n8n and Apify MCP. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/website-tech-stack-detector/pricing).
- [Company Contacts Finder: Emails, Phones, Socials & DNS](https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder): Find public company emails, phone numbers, LinkedIn and social profiles from website domains. Optionally inspect MX, SPF and DMARC records and email-provider signals. Structured JSON for B2B contact research, lead enrichment, n8n, Make and Apify MCP. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/company-contact-details-finder/pricing).
- [B2B Account Research & Enrichment: Tech, Hiring, Contacts](https://apify.com/hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent): Company domain in, one compact profile out: website technologies, email provider, job board with live open-job count, and public emails, phones and social profiles. No browser, no login. Charged only for useful profiles. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/b2b-account-research-agent/pricing).
- [AI Crawler Readiness Audit & llms.txt Draft](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ai-search-brand-visibility-radar): Audits public robots.txt rules for eight crawler tokens, HTTP headers, llms.txt and JSON-LD. Produces evidence-based drafts and local readiness heuristics. Does not measure citations in AI answers or guarantee rankings. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ai-search-brand-visibility-radar/pricing).
- [MCP & x402 Evidence Grader](https://apify.com/hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader): Fetch actual MCP tool catalogs or probe x402 v2 payment challenges. Local heuristics and owner-review drafts; no official Glama certification. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/mcp-x402-server-grader/pricing).
- [Shopify & WooCommerce to llms.txt: Catalog Draft](https://apify.com/hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator): Turn an accessible public Shopify or WooCommerce product feed into a reviewable llms.txt draft. Get sampled products, source evidence and text files. $0.02 per useful report; no deployment or promised AI rankings. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/shopify-to-llms-generator/pricing).
- [TikTok Product Research & Video Growth Radar](https://apify.com/hirepulse/viral-product-radar): Research TikTok product videos from exports or explicitly approved Clockworks collection. Included export is a dated example, not live market data. First observation is a baseline; repeat after 6+ hours for growth. $0.02 per delivered report plus optional collection fees. No sales forecast. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/viral-product-radar/pricing).
- [Temporary Email Inbox & OTP API for AI Agents](https://apify.com/hirepulse/temporary-email-inbox): Create private temporary email inboxes, list received-message metadata and extract numeric verification codes as JSON. Built for authorized QA, n8n and AI agents. Inbox TTL 1–60 minutes. Pay through Apify; no separate service account or crypto wallet required. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/temporary-email-inbox/pricing).
- [Website & AI Crawler Audit: Public Page Signals](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ad-waste-and-ai-leak-auditor): Inspect homepage HTML, technology markers, robots.txt and llms.txt. Return HTTP evidence and observed public emails. Scores are static checklist heuristics, not measured conversion loss, AI rankings or verified decision-maker identity. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/ad-waste-and-ai-leak-auditor/pricing).
- [Startup Breakout & Growth Radar](https://apify.com/hirepulse/startup-breakout-radar): Research up to 50 company domains for startup growth signals: ATS hiring intent, Google Ads Transparency, website technologies and public business contacts. Evidence-backed breakout scores with reasons. Pay only for profiles with at least two data sections. [Current pricing](https://apify.com/hirepulse/startup-breakout-radar/pricing).

## Run through Apify

Run an Actor in Apify Console or use the REST API and an existing Apify token. Put the token in the Authorization Bearer header, not in public links or client-side code. To start: POST /v2/actors/hirepulse~ACTOR_NAME/runs, with the Actor input JSON and maxTotalChargeUsd, timeout and memory query parameters. Poll the returned run ID and inspect its dataset and OUTPUT diagnostics. Do not automatically repeat a run-start POST after a timeout.

[Bounded Python runner](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/examples/apify-bounded-run.py).
Use the Apify integration in n8n or Make, or the official Apify MCP server: https://mcp.apify.com . These Actors are distinct from the separate HirePulse gateway and its prices.

## Source and billing limits

Public/native SEO and keyword modes do not measure traffic, Google ranking positions, volume or CPC. Crawler readiness is an HTTP checklist, not AI answer citation tracking. llms.txt output is a draft, not deployment or a sales guarantee. A first hiring snapshot is a baseline, not a hiring spike. A successful run can still contain source diagnostics or no useful data. Review the actual output.

Apify Actor events, external collection and applicable platform/storage charges must be considered separately. The live Pricing tab controls current rates; there is no blanket free-run promise. No search ranking, future source availability or customer outcome is guaranteed.
